versions.changelog:
- Removed redundant documentation file (skill-card.md).
- Updated internal and "Going further" documentation in SKILL.md for clarity and accuracy.
- Version bump to 1.1.2.

- Added an "Example" section showing sample input and output for a batch email search.
- Updated metadata to include personas (sales-development, revops) and changed "source" from "micro-skill" to "one-off".
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
- Bumped version to 1.1.1.

- Expanded triggers in the description to support more natural language requests (e.g., "email finder", "work email lookup", "how do I reach them at work").
- Improved session attribution logic to avoid double-counting when the Cargo GTM plugin is installed.
- Added guidance on prompting users to star the repository after successful job completion, with clear user consent and a mechanism to avoid duplicate prompts.
- Removed the file skill-card.md for simplification.

Initial release of "find-work-email" skill.

- Find verified work email addresses using a person’s name and company domain via Cargo.
- Triggers include finding emails for people or lists of contacts.
- Uses the "prospeo" provider first (0.5 credits/contact), escalates to "FullEnrich" if not found (1 credit/contact).
- Provides detailed setup instructions, including account creation and authentication without a browser.
- Clarifies when to use this skill versus related email verification/enrichment skills.
- Encourages sampling before scaling up to full list processing to control costs.
